a51df6d9e2d31b44be9adb6bc8732517db6bf96b: Reindenting large tuple lists caused quadratic CPU consumption (GHSA-cfqr-cjx5-5jcm); fixed by measuring offsets backwards; now protected by test_a51df6d9e2.py.
d1d80602741f77ec78e5a04ce4719244cf32352e: Dollar-quoted literals and multiline comments triggered O(n²) re-scanning on adversarial input (GHSA-prg7-hcfm-mfcr); fixed by a pre-processing pass; code has since moved so the fix cannot be probed against its original location.
ef2012a5eeb491e604dea2b00d516904a3830c87: A comment-only statement caused quadratic DoS in group_comments (GHSA-f2ff-p2ww-7p4p); fixed by processing tokens in one forward pass; now protected by test_ef2012a5ee.py.
a194d3187b04b0aed7a935c3401f068236fb6264: A BETWEEN bound written as a leading-dot float (e.g. .03) demoted the preceding keyword from Keyword to Name; fixed by adding the pattern to the keyword regex; caught by an existing test.
f66d12c245412f28c58f045b646eb53c0e691b8b: get_real_name() returned the wrong component for identifiers with more than two dotted parts (e.g. db.schema.tbl.col returned 'schema' instead of 'col'); fixed by iterating to the last real name; caught by an existing test.
ac3b9e0b25627feb42a7053074b6549df81dcfaf: MATERIALIZED was tokenised as Name instead of Keyword, leaving it unaffected by keyword_case formatting; fixed by adding it to KEYWORDS; caught by an existing test.
111b35cffcfe44b16fbdd27507f165bafd52a2a1: Lowercase 'as' in CREATE TABLE AS SELECT left has_as False, causing the function-grouping guard to fire and skip all function grouping; fixed by case-folding the check; caught by an existing test.
26d7d652218757828b64cfe7914660d529ab21e3: ROW_FORMAT was tokenised as Name, causing the grouper to treat it as a table alias; fixed by adding it to KEYWORDS; caught by an existing test.
8f978caa7cc777d845d358bfc82ea30110395d32: Anonymous BEGIN...END blocks were incorrectly split into multiple statements; fixed by a stack-based splitter rewrite; code has since moved so the fix cannot be probed against its original location.
da67ac16b8fa2c5041458bee728c8a914bed2d37: When the grouping-limit was exceeded, functions silently returned None instead of raising SQLParseError; fixed by adding an explicit error raise; code has since moved.
5ca50a2ee9b39e9efeea33e01f132d628144fb69: BEGIN TRANSACTION...END TRANSACTION blocks were not split correctly, a regression introduced in v0.5.4; fixed by handling the TRANSACTION keyword; code has since moved.
1a3bfbd50b82c05d9adcc51bacba059671dc1bc7: Semicolons inside BEGIN...END blocks were treated as statement terminators, splitting a single statement into multiple fragments; fixed by tracking block depth; code has since moved.
e92a032c81d51a6645b4f8c32470481894818ba0: IF EXISTS inside a BEGIN...END block caused incorrect statement merging; fixed by adding IF to the keyword table for the splitter; code has since moved.
73c8ba3ae88b608d39740c0776fb15064232258e: strip_comments=True left a stray '--B' token when the statement contained only comments; fixed by a one-line filter correction; caught by an existing test.
694747fdbed387e05ba6904ed89183a42bb7c843: ATTACH and DETACH were not in KEYWORDS_PLPGSQL, so PostgreSQL ALTER TABLE DETACH PARTITION statements parsed them as Name tokens; fixed by adding the two keywords; now protected by test_694747fdbe.py.
af6df6c6627b5fcf98bc7bb46f780e1fa0d1a7ef: SQL hints (/*+ ... */) were deleted by strip_comments, causing loss of query optimiser hints; fixed by preserving hint-style block comments; code has since moved.
e48000a5d76ff4d762821708f99ca90962e25f46: EXTENSION was tokenised as Identifier rather than Keyword, producing wrong token types in DROP/CREATE EXTENSION statements; fixed by adding it to KEYWORDS; now protected by test_e48000a5d7.py.
b126ba5b2004474e9ad899456c077f976b761319: ASC/DESC NULLS FIRST/LAST were tokenised inconsistently, breaking ORDER BY formatting; fixed by adding NULLS FIRST/LAST as compound keywords; code has since moved.
0c4902f3f7aafa8c2e63a375ec307c210842f543: strip_whitespace=True failed to descend into sub-groups (e.g. CTE parentheses), leaving trailing spaces inside nested tokens; fixed by recursing into sub-groups; caught by an existing test.
791e25de46f443597d99314cfd1a68217bcaf970: Multiple CASE clauses inside a BEGIN block caused a single statement to be split into several; fixed by tracking CASE depth in the splitter; code has since moved.
bf74d8bc2c572b978997f7785747ad262025566c: No compact formatting option existed, leaving users with no way to suppress excessive newlines; fixed by adding reindent_aligned/compact; code has since moved.
8b0342730b2e53dcc7887e5b4563d479444ec0ba: Stripping an inline comment directly adjacent to a value fused it with the next keyword (e.g. '1AS foo'); fixed by preserving grouping boundaries in Comment handling; code has since moved.
e03b74e608b71dd06824c2cb42421c0d790248e3: Function.get_parameters() raised an error when the function had an OVER clause because it assumed the last token was always a Parenthesis; fixed by stopping at the first Parenthesis; caught by an existing test.
617b8f6cd3c55bacf2c80130901508518753f7e1: Window functions were not grouped with their OVER clause into a single Identifier; fixed by adding OVER-clause grouping; code has since moved.
46971e5a804b29e7dbd437155a8ceffab8ef1cd5: PRIMARY KEY was not recognised as a compound keyword, producing incorrect token structure in CREATE TABLE statements; fixed by adding a regex pattern; caught by an existing test.
d76e8a4425d82a6cd704b5e549a8cabefa931341: TRUNCATE was classified as DML instead of DDL, and GRANT/REVOKE as DML instead of DCL, causing ttype checks to return wrong results; fixed by correcting the keyword classifications; now protected by test_d76e8a4425.py.
8c24779e027e92a1ed379fc271e20f540b0f3d20: JSON operators (-> and ->>) in SELECT caused incorrect reindent alignment; fixed by grouping JSON-operator expressions before indenting; the check found no observable difference in current code.
6b05583f119224a43f8047159120edd0228ebd76: The -> operator was not recognised as a single token, so use_space_around_operators=True split it and produced invalid SQL; fixed by adding JSON-operator patterns; caught by an existing test.
5bb129d3fc8a4d031bd37fab8e5ee24a199a9b8c: The Lexer singleton was stored before keywords were fully loaded, causing intermittent failures in multi-threaded use; fixed by acquiring a lock during initialisation; code has since moved.
7334ac99152d02bb09ab0abe79377174c2867f7c: Statements following a GO keyword in Transact-SQL were typed as UNKNOWN instead of their true DML type; fixed by treating GO as a statement splitter; code has since moved.
39b5a02551de051b1e888135fe71759d5b49a134: group_order() was not recursive, so ORDER BY modifiers (DESC) inside sub-queries were not grouped; fixed by adding the @recurse decorator; caught by an existing test.
fac38cd03bea712e096222f16199a7482a4837da: copy.deepcopy() on a parsed statement raised TypeError because _TokenType.__deepcopy__ was missing and the class matched as callable; fixed by ignoring dunder attributes in __getattr__; caught by an existing test.
dd9d5b91d7aa30e4a000d5370f09dc99378891dc: get_type() returned UNKNOWN when a comment appeared between the WITH keyword and the CTE identifier; fixed by skipping comment tokens in the type-detection walk; caught by an existing test.
e9241945801808d1db7f76bdccbbe9a200042c37: The IN keyword was not uppercased by keyword_case='upper' after a regression introduced in 0.4.0; fixed by reverting the erroneous Comparison classification; code has since moved.
b72a8ff42f53cba0517b1dd9e8af051b4a060ecf: Unicode characters outside the ASCII range (e.g. Chinese ideographs) were not recognised as valid identifier characters, breaking reindentation; fixed by using \w in the regex; code has since moved.
403de6fc648ac4e012b60b49161c3f5f36dc944a: Lowercase 'create table' statements were not parsed correctly because keyword comparisons lacked .upper() calls; fixed by normalising case; code has since moved.
0bbfd5f8326fd4291c390858ba8ff482ff5ced70: DISTINCTROW (an MS Access keyword) was not in the keyword table, so it was tokenised as a Name; fixed by adding it to KEYWORDS; code has since moved.
e58781dd632584c783ef082257309ea5efdb6750: The INDICATOR keyword was misspelled as 'INDITCATOR' in the main keywords dict; fixed by correcting the typo; INDICATOR is also listed in a second keyword table, so it is a keyword with or without the fix, and taking the fix out changes nothing a test could catch.
e66046785b816e5c2d22f101f36faefd19c4a771: The scientific-notation regex used \d* (zero-or-more), causing aliases like 'e2' to be misclassified as float literals; fixed by changing to \d+; code has since moved.
